articles.title: Vertical Integration and Foreclosure in Digital Markets: Evidence from App Stores
articles.abstract: We study how platform self-preferencing in app store search results affects third-party developer entry, using quasi-experimental variation in ranking algorithm updates across two major platforms.

articles.title: The Ambiguous Economics of Most-Favored-Nation Clauses After Booking.com
articles.abstract: A reassessment of MFN clauses in online travel intermediation, contrasting the EU courts' narrowing of the platform MFN concept with subsequent entry patterns.

articles.title: Killer Acquisitions on Two-Sided Platforms: A Screening Approach
articles.abstract: We propose a merger screening rule for nascent platform acquisitions that incorporates expected network effects and dynamic entry incentives.

articles.title: The Rise of Antitrust Neo-Structuralism in the EU and US
articles.abstract: This article maps the doctrinal migration of structural presumptions from the 1960s to the 2023 Merger Guidelines, and evaluates their fit with digital market realities.

articles.title: Ex Post Evaluation of the DMA: Gatekeeper Compliance Costs
articles.abstract: First-year evidence on compliance costs under Articles 5 and 6 of the Digital Markets Act, based on disclosures by three gatekeepers.

articles.title: Ninety Years of the Robinson-Patman Act: Markets, Enforcement, and the New Interest in Price Discrimination
articles.abstract: A retrospective on secondary-line price discrimination doctrine and what revived enforcement interest means for modern algorithmic pricing.

articles.title: Remedies for Monopolization: Lessons from the Search Cases
articles.abstract: Comparing remedy design in United States v. Google with the Microsoft legacy, we argue behavioral remedies in platform cases face inherent monitoring limits.

articles.title: Hub-and-Spoke Information Exchange in Algorithmic Pricing Litigation
articles.abstract: The article develops a liability framework for algorithmic collusion scenarios where competing sellers adopt the same pricing software.

articles.title: Consistency Divergence: National Courts and the ECJ on Platform Liability Referrals
articles.journal: Journal of European Competition Law & Practice
articles.abstract: We document growing divergence among national courts in referring platform liability questions and propose a preliminary-ruling coordination mechanism.

articles.title: Article 102 and Sustainability Agreements: A Coherence Test
articles.journal: Journal of European Competition Law & Practice
articles.abstract: Can sustainability cooperation fit within Article 101(3)? We test the Commission's draft guidance against four decided cases.

articles.title: The Contractual Structure of Franchising: Evidence from Termination Clauses
articles.abstract: Using a new dataset of franchise agreements, we show termination clause strictness tracks repeat-dealer reputation mechanisms rather than raw bargaining power.

articles.title: Do Antitrust Damages Actions Deter? Evidence from Cartel Recidivism in the EU
articles.abstract: Private enforcement intensity varies widely across member states; we find deterrence effects concentrated where follow-on litigation is procedurally feasible.

articles.title: Punitive Damages and Settlement Behavior: An Empirical Study of Class Actions
articles.abstract: We estimate how punitive damage caps alter settlement timing and class certification outcomes using state-level variation.

articles.title: Standards of Review in Regulatory Appeals: Deference and Error Costs
articles.abstract: A formal model of appellate review standards traded against agency informational advantage, applied to net-neutrality rulemaking reversals.

articles.title: Behavioral Antitrust: The Second Wave
articles.abstract: Integrating bounded rationality findings into monopolization doctrine requires distinguishing consumer-side from competitor-side biases.

articles.title: The Unbundling of Legal Services After Alternative Business Structures
articles.abstract: Ten years of ABS data show entry concentrated in consumer legal tech, leaving small-business representation gaps.

articles.title: Labor Market Monopsony and Non-Compete Enforcement Spillovers
articles.abstract: State-level non-compete bans raise wages not only at constrained workers' employers but also at rivals, consistent with oligopsonistic externalities.

articles.title: Judicial Selection and the Economics of Opinion Length
articles.abstract: Elected judges write longer majority opinions in competitive districts; appointed judges do not respond to dissent threat similarly.

articles.title: Optimal Antitrust Enforcement with Asymmetric Detection Probabilities
articles.journal: International Review of Law and Economics
articles.abstract: When detection probabilities differ across cartel types, uniform fines over-deter some conspiracies and under-deter others; we derive the fine schedule.

articles.title: Contract Enforcement Institutions and Trade in Customized Goods
articles.journal: International Review of Law and Economics
articles.abstract: Cross-country evidence that relationship-specific exports respond to court procedural quality, with magnitudes comparable to tariff effects.

articles.title: From Rule of Reason to Algorithmic Reason: Structuring Effects Analysis
articles.abstract: A structured framework for weighing algorithmic evidence in rule-ofreason analysis, illustrated with retail pricing cases.

articles.title: Entry Thresholds and Concentration in Retail Platform Markets
articles.abstract: We estimate minimum viable scale for marketplace entry and show reported concentration understates contestability by new hybrid entrants.

articles.title: Two-Sided Pricing After Amex: Theory and Frequency
articles.abstract: Post-Amex pricing investigations increasingly rely on cross-group externality measurement; we assess the empirical strategies used so far.

articles.title: Vertical Mergers and the Marginal Buyer Problem
articles.abstract: Vertical integration changes input price commitments in ways that raise rivals' costs only under specific contracting frictions we characterize.

articles.title: Data as Input: Complementarities and De Novo Entry in AI Services
articles.abstract: Data complementarity advantages in AI service markets imply entry can occur at the application layer even when foundation model markets concentrate.

articles.title: Antitrust Federalism: State Attorneys General as Second Enforcers
articles.abstract: An empirical account of state AG participation in federal antitrust actions, its effects on settlement terms, and democratic-accountability implications.

articles.title: The Situational Character of Antitrust Remedies
articles.abstract: Remedy selection in platform cases should track the situational durability of the conduct at issue; structural remedies are not the default the new critics assume.

articles.title: Comments: The Economics of Notice-and-Comment in the Platform Age
articles.abstract: Agency rulemaking increasingly targets privately ordered platform governance; we assess how comment procedures handle technical evidence.

articles.title: Book Review: Antitrust's Uncertain Future(s)
articles.abstract: Reviewing three recent volumes on antitrust reform, this essay identifies points of unexpected convergence between the neo-Brandeisian and Chicago schools.

articles.title: Labor Platforms and the Fissured Workplace
articles.abstract: Algorithmic management in platform work standardizes tasks while fragmenting legal responsibility; we map doctrinal responses across five jurisdictions.
